dct_description_sm: This is supplementary data for the manuscript titled "Divergent plastid genomes in the deepest-branching apicomplexan parasites". Deposited here are the apicoplast genomes (plastid genomes) of eight species of archigregarines, from four genera (Selenidium, Lunidium, Metzidium, Devanium).
dct_title_s: Supplementary Data for: Divergent plastid genomes in the deepest-branching apicomplexan parasites
